title: ICU Respiratory Trainer Learning Pathway
description: Progressive 4-level curriculum advancing from ventilator literacy and respiratory mechanics to non-invasive support and complex ICU management.

levels.name: Ventilator literacy
levels.scope: Waveforms, modes, the equation of motion
levels.description: Foundational ventilator concepts: the equation of motion, volume vs pressure control, pressure support, and recognising normal waveforms.

unlockRule.description: Unlocked by default for all learners.

levels.name: Mechanics and gas exchange
levels.scope: Time constants, dead space, shunt, PEEP and FiO2
levels.description: Respiratory physiology and gas exchange: expiratory time constants, auto-PEEP, dead space, shunt physiology, and haemodynamic interactions.

unlockRule.description: Requires independent or mastered status in at least 3 of 4 Level 1 key competencies.

levels.name: Non-invasive support and common cases
levels.scope: HFNC, NIV, COPD, pulmonary oedema, pneumonia
levels.description: Acute non-invasive support and common ward/ICU presentations: high-flow nasal cannula, non-invasive ventilation, acute exacerbation of COPD, cardiogenic pulmonary oedema, and severe pneumonia.

unlockRule.description: Requires independent or mastered status in Level 2 competencies.

levels.name: ICU decisions
levels.description: Complex ICU decision-making: severe ARDS lung protection, severe asthma and obstruction, ventilator dyssynchrony management, acute crisis troubleshooting, and spontaneous breathing trials and liberation.

unlockRule.description: Requires independent or mastered status in Level 3 competencies.
